note: Decode at depth, via llama-bench -d. -d prefills the KV cache to that depth with real tokens and then times generation; -p/-n alone would time generation from an EMPTY cache regardless of -p, which is what the ctx-128 slot records. The depth-0 sample reproduces the pinned KIMI_K3_H200X8_IQ1S_LLAMA_128 (18.3210) to within 0.67%, which is what makes this run comparable to it.
